'''Cela Len''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Residing at the [[Promenade]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], she provided the knowledge of synthweaving to others.
